integrity: Proof checked using an exact polynomial identity, rational interval LDL pivot certificates through degree 161, and the analytic Bernstein–Gershgorin tail. Script is self-contained and reproducible; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The universal two-resonance law concerns the specified signed position contrasts, not all possible rank defects for arbitrary cubic-orbit parameter. Exact-degree ranks are proved fully only for the truncated cube, and at degree nine for its rhombicuboctahedral companion. Historical uniqueness and independent mathematical verification remain open.
title: A two-resonance law for degree-nine cubic-orbit harmonics and complete truncated-cube ranks
